question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Ephemeral
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fleeting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ephemeral"** means lasting for a very short time; something that is temporary or momentary. (क्षणभंगुर)

 
 
• **Example:** The beauty of a sunset is ephemeral, disappearing as the night approaches.
 
 
 
• **"Fleeting"** is a synonym of ephemeral, meaning something that passes swiftly, is short-lived, or momentary. (क्षणिक)
 
 
• **Example:** Their happiness was fleeting, as reality quickly set in.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the most appropriate synonym of **'Ephemeral'** is **'Fleeting'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Fleeting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Persistent** (दृढ़): Continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition.

 
 
• **Example:** Her persistent efforts finally paid off, and she achieved her goal.
 
 
 
• **Durable** (टिकाऊ): Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; long-lasting.
 
 
• **Example:** The new phone is highly durable and can survive accidental drops.
 
 
 
• **Permanent** (स्थायी): Lasting or intended to last or remain unchanged indefinitely.
 
 
• **Example:** The couple decided to settle in a permanent residence after traveling for years.
